statement: A 2026 preprint argues that global protein-sequence thresholds can miss target mirroring and reports thousands of correlated ChEMBL36 assay pairs plus unexpectedly strong ligand-only baselines on commonly used affinity benchmarks.

notes: Not peer reviewed. Retain as adversarial evidence and reproduce before promoting any dependent claim.
